name: Survival Circle
source:
Trapped university students in a collapsed building. Strange events happening inside the building.

Who? Why are such things happening?

Build relationships with other survivors and uncover your own truth through various stories!

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2640370/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
大学生被困在倒塌的建筑物中。大楼内发生了奇怪的事件。

WHO？为什么会发生这样的事情呢？

与其他幸存者建立关系，并通过各种故事揭开自己的真相！

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2640370/]Steam[/url]]
